name: Hybrid Lexical-Dense Retrieval with RRF
mechanism: Runs lexical and dense retrieval independently and merges their ranked lists with deterministic reciprocal-rank fusion.
use_when: The workload mixes exact identifiers with conceptual questions
Lexical and dense paths show complementary relevant-document recall
avoid_when: One retriever already saturates intended-slice recall
A second index and query path exceed the latency or maintenance budget
expected_effects: Broader recall across heterogeneous query classes
Stable fusion without calibrating incomparable raw scores
failure_modes: Duplicate or near-duplicate candidates consume depth
Latency and operational cost increase without material gain
required_evals: nDCG by exact and semantic slices
p50 and p95 latency plus index cost
